descriptor.label: Firecrawl Search
descriptor.description: Search the web using Firecrawl v2/search. Supports includeDomains/excludeDomains filtering and tbs time filters (day/week/month/year). Can optionally include scraped content from result pages.

sources.description: Optional sources list, for example ["web"], ["news"], or ["images"].

categories.description: Optional Firecrawl categories, for example ["github"] or ["research"].

includeDomains.description: Restrict results to these hostnames (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with excludeDomains.

excludeDomains.description: Exclude these hostnames from results (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with includeDomains.

tbs.description: Time-based filter, for example "qdr:d" (day), "qdr:w" (week), "qdr:m", "qdr:y", or "sbd:1" to sort by date.

location.description: Geo-target location, for example "Germany" or "San Francisco,California,United States".

country.description: ISO country code for geo-targeting, for example "US", "DE", or "JP".

scrapeResults.description: Include scraped result content when Firecrawl returns it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the Firecrawl Search request.

providerMetadata.label: Firecrawl Search
providerMetadata.hint: Structured results with optional result scraping

descriptor.name: firecrawl_search
descriptor.label: Firecrawl Search
descriptor.description: Search the web using Firecrawl v2/search. Supports includeDomains/excludeDomains filtering and tbs time filters (day/week/month/year). Can optionally include scraped content from result pages.

sources.description: Optional sources list, for example ["web"], ["news"], or ["images"].

categories.description: Optional Firecrawl categories, for example ["github"] or ["research"].

includeDomains.description: Restrict results to these hostnames (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with excludeDomains.

excludeDomains.description: Exclude these hostnames from results (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with includeDomains.

tbs.description: Time-based filter, for example "qdr:d" (day), "qdr:w" (week), "qdr:m", "qdr:y", or "sbd:1" to sort by date.

location.description: Geo-target location, for example "Germany" or "San Francisco,California,United States".

country.description: ISO country code for geo-targeting, for example "US", "DE", or "JP".

scrapeResults.description: Include scraped result content when Firecrawl returns it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the Firecrawl Search request.

providerMetadata.label: Firecrawl Search
providerMetadata.hint: Structured results with optional result scraping

descriptor.name: firecrawl_search
descriptor.label: Firecrawl Search
descriptor.description: Search the web using Firecrawl v2/search. Supports includeDomains/excludeDomains filtering and tbs time filters (day/week/month/year). Can optionally include scraped content from result pages.

sources.description: Optional sources list, for example ["web"], ["news"], or ["images"].

categories.description: Optional Firecrawl categories, for example ["github"] or ["research"].

includeDomains.description: Restrict results to these hostnames (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with excludeDomains.

excludeDomains.description: Exclude these hostnames from results (no protocol or path). Cannot be combined with includeDomains.

tbs.description: Time-based filter, for example "qdr:d" (day), "qdr:w" (week), "qdr:m", "qdr:y", or "sbd:1" to sort by date.

location.description: Geo-target location, for example "Germany" or "San Francisco,California,United States".

country.description: ISO country code for geo-targeting, for example "US", "DE", or "JP".

scrapeResults.description: Include scraped result content when Firecrawl returns it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the Firecrawl Search request.

providerMetadata.label: Firecrawl Search
providerMetadata.hint: Structured results with optional result scraping
